# CXY Studio

> CXY Studio is an independent app studio by Kai Chen. This site is the official product directory; each product page links to its authoritative App Store listing.

## Official developer

- Website: https://chenkaitech.github.io/
- App Store developer page: https://apps.apple.com/il/developer/kai-chen/id1818964633

## Product principles

- Focused, useful tools that respect the user’s time and attention.
- Refer to the linked App Store page for the latest compatibility, price, privacy label, and download information.
